Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Enhance sanity tests with functional verification and progressive UI

- Add loopback echo test \(guaranteed pass if driver supports loopback\)
- Add bus response test \(depends on connected ECU\)
- Periodic message test now verifies messages appear via loopback
- Filter test verifies filtering works by sending matching/non-matching IDs
- Sanity results display progressively as each step completes
- Make sanity report panel scrollable
- Use broadcast ID 0x7DF for OBD-II requests
EOF
\)")
